name: Cox Brothers Food Equipment Repair
old_description: Cox Brothers has been in business serving restaurants, grocery stores and convenience stores in Mid-Missouri since 2002. Our techs are skilled at repairing Commercial Refrigeration equipment, ice machines, coffee, soda, beverage systems and any type of gas or electric food equipment. Our highest priorities are fast and dependable service. We work hard to be easy to contact any time you need us. We care about helping our customers make good decisions about keeping their equipment running reliably. When your equipment breaks down we do the best we can to recommend your best course of action, whether repair or replacement is the best choice. about:
Cox Brothers Food Equipment Repair was established in 2002 in Rolla, Missouri, and is owned by Nick Cox. The company began serving restaurants, grocery stores, and convenience stores across Mid-Missouri with a focus on commercial refrigeration and food equipment repair.

The business provides repair and maintenance for commercial refrigeration equipment, ice machines, coffee, soda, and beverage systems, as well as gas and electric food equipment, HVAC systems, walk-in and reach-in coolers and freezers. A team of service technicians, led by a lead technician, performs on-site repairs and offers scheduled maintenance plans to keep equipment running reliably. The technicians are skilled across a broad range of equipment types, from beer systems to reach-in freezers.

Customers include independent restaurants, grocery stores, and convenience stores throughout the Mid-Missouri region. The company works with any type of gas or electric food equipment, providing both emergency repairs and planned maintenance.

The company emphasizes fast, dependable service and easy accessibility, aiming to help customers make informed decisions about whether to repair or replace failing equipment. Scheduled maintenance plans are offered alongside rapid response for breakdowns.
